uplink.description: Status report, probe0 wet, probe1 dry
uplink._note: TTN status example input (reference/upstream-examples.json). Cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt 3.0, WaterLeak_1 Leak, WaterLeak_2 NoLeak): bytes[4] -> probe0 leak true, bytes[5] -> probe1 leak false.

uplink.description: Probes differ the other way: probe0 dry, probe1 wet (the case the retired any-probe OR could not express)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame: the TTN status example with the two probe bytes swapped; cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js (WaterLeak_1 NoLeak, WaterLeak_2 Leak). Pins entry order to the wire order and exercises per-position truth: the old top-level water.leak OR read `true` here with no way to say which probe was wet.
Synthetic in-bounds frame, both probes dry, battery 2.8 V. expected.data authored here; cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt 2.8, both WaterLeak NoLeak).

uplink.description: Status report, both probes wet, low-battery flag set
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame, both probes leak, byte[3]=156 (0x80|28) sets the low-battery flag, masked voltage 2.8 V. Cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt '2.8(low battery)', both WaterLeak Leak). battery / lowBattery are whole-device readings and stay top-level.
TTN startup version report (reportType 0x00): carries SW/HW version + datecode, not a measurement, so we error.
TTN ConfigReportRsp on fPort 7: configuration traffic, not a measurement uplink, so we error.
